extracted.intended_audience: NIH eRA Commons users (PIs, Signing Officials, Grants Financial/FSR delegates, Scientific Review Officers, Grants Management Specialists)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and policy guidance for using the eRA Commons Status and Closeout modules (viewing status, handling eSubmission errors/warnings, closeout tasks including FFR, Final RPPR, Final Invention Statement, FRAM, and related document links). Targets institutional roles (PI, SO, FSR).

rubrics_metrics.name: eSubmission status check
rubrics_metrics.description: Check the eSubmission Status column to determine if your application status is “eSubmission Error” or “Pending Verification”.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Errors will stop the submission process and require a change/corrected application; warnings will not stop submission but should still be checked to ensure they do not apply to your application. View errors/warnings via Show Prior Errors link or by opening the Status Information page for Pending Verification (accession number).

rubrics_metrics.name: Show Prior Errors and Warnings link
rubrics_metrics.description: Selecting the Show Prior Errors and Warnings link opens the Errors/Warnings for Prior Failed eSubmissions screen and displays any errors or warnings received for the application during eSubmission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this to review any prior submission problems so you can correct issues before final submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status Information: display of eSubmission errors/warnings
rubrics_metrics.description: If there are any unresolved errors or warnings associated with the selected application, a message indicating the error(s) or warning(s) is displayed at the top of the Status Information screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open Status Information by selecting the Application Number link from any Status result screen to view current submission problems during the two-day review period before the submission deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Grant Information fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Status Information includes General Grant Information such as Status, Institution Name, School Name, School Category, Division Name, Department Name, PI Name, Application ID, Proposal Title, Proposal Receipt Date, Last Status Update Date, Current Award Notice Date, Application Source, Project Period Begin Date, Project Period End Date, eApplication Status, FOA, NIH Appl ID.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these fields to verify application identity and current administrative metadata; note Proposal Title may include special annotations (e.g., NFP).

rubrics_metrics.name: NFP annotation meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Proposal Title field, NFP (no further processing) is added to the application title to indicate that the application will not be referred for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If NFP appears in the Proposal Title, the application will not be reviewed further.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Relevant Documents links
rubrics_metrics.description: Status Information's Other Relevant Documents section may include links to application/grant-related documents such as Abstract, Additions for Review, Administrative Supplement(s), Appendices (Appendix 1–10), Closeout FRAM, Component Appendices, e-Application, Final Invention Statement, Final Progress Report, Fellowship Proposal Face Page, FRAM Submission, Institute/Center PRAM, Just in Time, FFR/FSR, Notices of Grant Award, Multi Year Progress Reports, Progress Report Face Page, PRAM, Relinquishing Statements, Research Performance Progress Report, Summary Statement, Unfunded Progress Report, xTrain training appointment/termination notices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these links to access PDFs or uploaded files relevant to review, closeout, and award administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence section fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Correspondence displays letters/emails regarding the application or grant (broken into Referral, Closeout, Other) and provides Date, Description, and a View link to open the PDF version of the correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review correspondence to see official communications from Agency staff; use the View link to read full text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status History fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Status History provides a history of the life of the application from submitted to awarded and displays Effective Date and Status Message.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Status History to track lifecycle events and status changes for the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institute/Center Assignment fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Institute or Center Assignment displays a history of assignments for the application including Institute or Center and Assignment Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult this section to see which IC and when the application was assigned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Information fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Application Information provides additional items such as Award Document Number, FRS Accepted Code, Snap Indicator Code, Review Outcome Available, Summary Statement Available, Early Stage Investigator Eligible, New Investigator Eligible, Eligible for FFATA Reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these fields for award and compliance-related metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study Section information fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Study Section details available include Scientific Review Group, Council Meeting Date, Meeting Date, Meeting Time, and Study Roster (link to view Meeting Roster).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check Study Section details to know review meeting schedules and membership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advisory Council information
rubrics_metrics.description: Advisory Council (AC) Information displays Meeting Date and Meeting Time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to track council-level review/consideration timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letter metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference Letter(s) lists Referee Name, Organization Affiliation, Department, Email, and Submitted status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIs can also view reference letter information in their Personal Profile; see Reference Letters help topic for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacts section details
rubrics_metrics.description: Contacts displays names, phone numbers, and email addresses for grant-related contacts including Scientific Review Officer (SRO), Grants Management Specialist (GMS), and Program Official (PO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these contacts for questions about review, grants management, or programmatic issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards financial fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards section provides awarded dollar amounts including Direct Amount, Facilities and Administrative, Fee Amount, and Total Amount.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to confirm award financial terms and totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additions for Review: categories and document handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Additions for Review provides links to uploaded additional material (uploaded by SRO) categorized by Group (e.g., Updated Pages; Supplemental Material; Collaboration Letters; Modified Budget Pages; Accepted Publication; Biographical Sketches; Other). Document displays the file name as a link (view/update/save) and Date shows upload date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants can view and, where allowed, update or save copies of uploaded additions; category indicates the purpose of the material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Supplements: purpose and columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative Supplements are requests for or awards of additional funds during a current project period to cover increased costs due to unforeseen circumstances. The Administrative Supplements table includes Identifying Information (grant number link to open the PDF), Accession Number, Supplement Status, Submitted Date, and Comments for Grantee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this screen to view read-only details of administrative supplement requests/awards and to access the supplement PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institute/Center PRAM Requests: fields and consolidated report
rubrics_metrics.description: PRAM requests screen provides Identifying Information (link to read-only PRAM request details), Requested Date, Number of Reminders Sent, Last Reminder Sent Date; link to a consolidated Progress Report Additional Materials file (PDF) shows submitted materials with headers for each submission, most recent first, with bookmarks for navigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the consolidated report to access all uploaded materials that respond to the PRAM request; check reminder history and updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishing Statements requirement and fields
rubrics_metrics.description: A relinquishing statement is required as part of the Change of Institution process to transfer an active grant to another institution; initiated by the Signing Official of the holding institution. The Relinquishing Statements screen displays Document Name (link to read-only form), Status, Submitted Date, and Comments for Grantee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the SO can submit the Relinquishing Statement; view status and any agency comments in this screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout FRAM Requests screen fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Closeout Final Report Additional Materials Request (FRAM) screen provides read-only access to current Closeout FRAM requests and associated identifying information, Requested Date, Number of Reminders Sent, and Last Reminder Sent Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this screen to access FRAM request details and respond via the Closeout module.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing Summary Statement policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary Statements (PDFs combining reviewers' written comments and the SRO's summary) are viewable by the PI via the Status Information screen once released by the SRO following the review meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open Status, select List of Applications/Grants, click the application ID, then select Summary Statement link in Other Relevant Documents to open the PDF in a separate window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Award (NOA) policy and viewing
rubrics_metrics.description: NOAs are sent to the email address specified in the Institutional Profile (SO can update); NOAs are also available via Status Information under Other Relevant Documents as a date link next to 'Notice(s) of Grant Award (PDF)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To view NOA: Log into Commons, open Status, go to List of Applications/Grants, select application ID, and click the NOA link (opens in a separate window).

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout policy & obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Closeout allows grantees to electronically file information necessary to complete grant closeout requirements. NIH will close grants as soon as possible after expiration or termination; closeout includes timely submission of all required reports and adjustments for amounts due. Closeout does not automatically cancel property accountability, record retention, or financial accountability; grantees remain obligated to return funds as required and the Federal Government may recover amounts based on audits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all required final reports and adjustments are submitted; understand continuing obligations after closeout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unilateral closeout timing (HHS/NIH policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies should initiate unilateral closeout 180 days after the project end date if acceptable final reports have not been received; ICs must close all awards no later than 270 days after the project end date if final reports remain unreceived.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ICs will make reasonable efforts to obtain final reports before initiating unilateral closeout; check Closeout Status for unilateral closeout indicators and disabled action links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout Status screen header & action links
rubrics_metrics.description: Closeout Status top displays Grant Number, PI Name, Closeout Contact Name/Email/Phone, Project Period, Proposal Title. The Closeout Submission Requirement area shows instruction, status of requirement, result of actions, date of action, and available action links (which may include FFR Create/View, Final RPPR Process/View/FRAM, Final Invention Statement Process/View).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these action links to complete closeout tasks; available links depend on role and current status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout status link meanings & link availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Closeout result screens may show links such as Requires Closeout (grant not completed closeout), Closed (grant completed closeout), In Unilateral Closeout (currently being unilaterally closed), Unilaterally Closed (IC has unilaterally closed grant). While In Unilateral Closeout, links may be available unless disabled by Grants Management Staff; when Unilaterally Closed, links will not be available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Screen will indicate whether links have been disabled; contact Grants Management if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Financial Report (FFR) module functions & role requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: An FFR is a statement of expenditures associated with a grant. Users with the FSR role can Create a new FFR, View an FFR, Submit an FFR, and Revise an FFR; FSRs can access the FFR module from the Closeout Status screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the Commons Online Help or FFR user guide PDF for detailed instructions on preparing and submitting expenditure data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Invention Statement (FIS) deadline & scope
rubrics_metrics.description: You must submit a Final Invention Statement within 90 days following the termination of a grant award. The statement should include all inventions that were conceived or first reduced to practice during the course of work under the grant from the original effective date of support through the date of completion or termination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the Procedure for Submission of Final Invention Statement and Certification for policy details; SO must verify and submit the FIS to Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: FIS: who can create/submit and required fields to report an invention
rubrics_metrics.description: A PI can create the FIS, but only an SO can submit it to the Agency. To add an invention, required fields include Title of Invention, Name of Inventor, and Date Reported to DHHS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After adding inventions, select Save to generate a certification pop-up; SO must verify and submit. PIs will see status 'Awaiting SO Verification' if they save the FIS.

rubrics_metrics.name: FIS save/update/remove flow and statuses
rubrics_metrics.description: When saved: Status = Saved (if SO) or Awaiting SO Verification (if PI); Result of Actions = Submitted by <your name>; Date = current date/date saved; Action = Process Final Invention Statement link. SOs can change a saved FIS (Change) to re-select Yes/No or add/remove inventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need to remove an invention before submission, use the Remove link in the Saved Invention section. Only SO can submit; once submitted, the FIS cannot be updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claiming no inventions on FIS
rubrics_metrics.description: To certify no inventions existed, select Process Final Invention Statement, choose No, confirm the certification statement that 'no inventions were conceived or first actually reduced to practice during the course of work', and select OK. The SO must submit the FIS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Saved no-invention FIS will show Status = Saved and Result of Actions = Submitted by <your name> until SO submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitting the FIS (SO only) and certification
rubrics_metrics.description: SO selects View Invention Statement to verify accuracy, then selects Submit. A certification statement displays and SO must select OK to confirm. After submission, Status = Received, Result of Actions = Verified by <your name>, Date = date submitted, Action = View (report is viewable but cannot be updated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once submitted by the SO the FIS cannot be changed; ensure accuracy before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final RPPR requirement and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: A Final Research Performance Progress Report (Final RPPR) is required for any grant that has ended and any grant that is not to be extended through award of a new competitive segment. The report is due within 120 days of the end of the project period and should be prepared in accordance with instructions provided by the awarding component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a renewal application is submitted on or before the Final RPPR due date, an Interim RPPR (IRPPR) must be submitted via eRA Commons; Interim and Final RPPRs are identical in process and information except for limited differences described separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interim RPPR vs Final RPPR differences
rubrics_metrics.description: Interim RPPR (used when a renewal application is submitted) and Final RPPR are identical in process and format to the annual RPPR except: In the Interim/Final RPPR only Section D.1 is required in the Participants section; Sections F (Changes) and H (Budget) are not part of Interim/Final RPPR; Section I (Outcomes) is new and is required for both Interim and Final RPPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare Final/Interim RPPR with attention to these section differences; follow awarding component instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final RPPR submission workflow & save guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit Final RPPR: From Closeout Status select Process Final RPPR, click Initiate to create, then Edit to navigate sections; complete each required section and click SAVE when moving between sections. Final RPPR Menu provides action buttons for Editing the RPPR Forms, Checking for Errors and Warnings, Viewing the RPPR, Routing the RPPR, Recalling the RPPR, and Submitting RPPR to Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure to save frequently to avoid lost data; use the provided workflow actions to validate and route the report prior to submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Progress Report Additional Materials (FRAM) request & upload rules
rubrics_metrics.description: When a Program Official requests additional materials related to the Final RPPR (FRAM), PI (and SO) receive an email notification; Final RPPR status updates to FRAM Requested, the Result of Action shows 'FRAM Requested By <PO Name>', and FRAM Update link appears in the Closeout Status screen. The PI is responsible for uploading attachments responding to the FRAM request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To upload FRAM use the FRAM Update link, add attachments via Add Attachment; attached document must be in PDF format and no larger than 6MB. The original FRAM request can be viewed via the Closeout FRAM link in Other Relevant Documents on Status Information.
